1 // Gandalf advisor — the REFUTATION-DISCIPLINE seam (Wave 4 / the NS4 honesty spine).
2 //
3 // NS4: a "vetted, value-adding suggestion" must survive an INDEPENDENT named-defeater
4 // refutation; only the REFUTED is dropped; nothing unverified is asserted as real. This
5 // module is the single seam that decides, deterministically:
6 //   • whether an elevation FIRES the refuter (value-if-true ≥ HIGH OR severity ≥ major, from
7 //     prereg-constants.json) — only those earn an INDEPENDENT named-defeater refuter;
8 //   • what counts as a NAMED CONCRETE DEFEATER vs a self-rated confidence word — the latter is
9 //     NOT a refutation, so the B-honesty canary FAILS / auto-downgrades it;
10 //   • the BOUNDED refuter budget R (=3): at the SEAM level assertRefuterBudget still throws
11 //     (the unit tripwire), but the LIVE path (runtime/live-refuter.mjs) pre-flights and FLOORS
12 //     excess — top-R refuted, the rest ship SPECULATIVE, each named (2026-08-25, John's ruling:
13 //     cost is a pre-flight conversation, never a mid-run wall); and
14 //   • the honest un-refuted floor: a finding that did NOT earn an independent refutation ships
15 //     SPECULATIVE carrying the "no independent refutation ran" stamp.
16 //
17 // Two honesty invariants are load-bearing here and are enforced at the deterministic gate
18 // (test/harness.mjs `assertHonestRefutation` + `assertRefutationSeam`; the budget HALT is a
19 // NAMED canary over `assertRefuterBudget`), label/semantic TRUTH staying the advisory layer's
20 // job (PRINCIPLE-D):
21 //   • NAMED DEFEATER, NOT A CONFIDENCE WORD. An elevation stamped above SPECULATIVE must carry
22 //     a named concrete defeater (`what_would_refute_it`) plus a `refutation_provenance` proving
23 //     an independent refuter ran. A self-rated confidence word ("very confident") is not a
24 //     refutation — B-honesty FAILS it (auto-downgrade to SPECULATIVE + stamp).
25 //   • BOUNDED BUDGET, NO SILENT DROP. The seam's assertRefuterBudget throws on excess (unit
26 //     tripwire); the live path FLOORS instead of halting — excess elevations ship SPECULATIVE
27 //     with a NAMED dispatch entry each (never silently taking the first R, never killing the run).
28 //
29 // PRINCIPLE-D: the live refuter `agent()` spawn is NOT in the gate. This seam mints the typed
30 // refutation ENVELOPE + the budget guard (the deterministic surface); actually dispatching the
31 // independent refuter to the trio `agent()` seam is the integration point the gate never runs.
32 //
33 // Public surface:
34 //   REFUTER_BUDGET_R                       — the bounded budget (=3, from prereg-constants.json)
35 //   REFUTER_FIRING_THRESHOLD               — value-if-true / severity floor that fires a refuter
36 //   firesRefuter(item)                     — does this elevation/finding earn an independent refuter?
37 //   CONFIDENCE_WORDS / isConfidenceWord    — the self-rated confidence vocabulary (NOT a defeater)
38 //   isNamedDefeater(text)                  — a populated, non-confidence-word concrete defeater
39 //   REFUTATION_PROVENANCE_KIND             — the refutation_provenance envelope marker
40 //   elevationIdentity(elevation)           — the stable claim-binding identity (id + reasoning + defeater
41 //                                            + payload verdict/severity/value_if_true — every smuggle field)
42 //   computeResultDigest({elevation,...})   — stable SHA-256 CLAIM-BOUND to the elevation identity + the
43 //                                            refuter's defeater+verdict content (W2a; replay-hardened)
44 //   composeRefutationProvenance(stages)    — mint an independent named-defeater provenance envelope
45 //                                            (W2a: also carries drafter_family / refuter_family / result_digest)
46 //   isCrossFamilyRefutation(elev, resolve) — W2b: DERIVE cross-family (GROUNDED) eligibility from the
47 //                                            ledger — authentic + family-distinct + digest-matched
48 //   NOOP_COMMISSION_VERIFIER               — the inert default commission verifier for the W2a injection seam
49 //   NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP        — the honest un-refuted-floor stamp string
50 //   SPECULATIVE_TIER                       — the honest floor tier
51 //   stampNoIndependentRefutation(finding)  — downgrade a finding to the stamped SPECULATIVE floor
52 //   hasNoIndependentRefutationStamp(f)     — predicate: carries the honest un-refuted stamp
53 //   vetElevationRefutation(elevation)      — keep the tier if honestly refuted, else auto-downgrade
54 //   RefuterBudgetHalt                      — the HALT error class for an over-budget request
55 //   assertRefuterBudget(requested[, R])    — throws RefuterBudgetHalt when requested > R (no drop)

57 import crypto from 'node:crypto';
58 import CONSTANTS from '../prereg-constants.json' with { type: 'json' };
59 
60 // --- self-contained helpers (the seam imports only the frozen constants) -------------------
61 function isNonEmptyString(v) {
62   return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '';
63 }
64 function isNonEmpty(v) {
65   if (v === undefined || v === null) return false;
66   if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length > 0;
67   if (typeof v === 'string') return v.trim() !== '';
68   if (typeof v === 'object') return Object.keys(v).length > 0;
69   return true; // numbers, booleans
70 }
71 
72 // --- the refuter-firing threshold (only high-value elevations earn an independent refuter) --
73 /** The bounded refuter budget R, the single source of truth being prereg-constants.json. */
74 export const REFUTER_BUDGET_R = CONSTANTS.refuter_budget_R;
75 
76 /** The refuter-firing threshold: an elevation earns an INDEPENDENT named-defeater refuter only
77  *  when value-if-true ≥ HIGH OR severity ≥ major. Sourced from prereg-constants.json so the
78  *  build-time frozen value is never re-typed (no drift). */
79 export const REFUTER_FIRING_THRESHOLD = CONSTANTS.refuter_firing_threshold;
80 
81 // Ladders local to the seam (low → high); the harness mirrors these and asserts agreement.
82 const VALUE_LADDER = ['low', 'medium', 'high'];
83 const SEVERITY_LADDER = ['minor', 'major', 'critical'];
84 
85 /** Does `item` (an elevation or finding) FIRE the refuter — i.e. earn an independent
86  *  named-defeater refuter? True iff value_if_true ≥ the threshold floor OR severity ≥ the
87  *  threshold floor (from REFUTER_FIRING_THRESHOLD). Below the threshold, no refuter runs and
88  *  the finding ships SPECULATIVE with the no-independent-refutation stamp. Pure; never throws. */
89 export function firesRefuter(item) {
90   if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object') return false;
91   const vFloor = VALUE_LADDER.indexOf(REFUTER_FIRING_THRESHOLD.value_if_true_at_least);
92   const sFloor = SEVERITY_LADDER.indexOf(REFUTER_FIRING_THRESHOLD.or_severity_at_least);
93   const vIdx = VALUE_LADDER.indexOf(item.value_if_true);
94   const sIdx = SEVERITY_LADDER.indexOf(item.severity);
95   const valueFires = vIdx !== -1 && vFloor !== -1 && vIdx >= vFloor;
96   const severityFires = sIdx !== -1 && sFloor !== -1 && sIdx >= sFloor;
97   return valueFires || severityFires;
98 }
99 
100 // --- named concrete defeater vs self-rated confidence word ---------------------------------
101 /** The self-rated confidence vocabulary. A `what_would_refute_it` whose WHOLE value (after
102  *  case/punctuation normalization) is one of these is a confidence SELF-RATING, not a named
103  *  concrete defeater — it names no falsifying observation, so it cannot vet an elevation. */
104 export const CONFIDENCE_WORDS = new Set([
105   'likely', 'very likely', 'unlikely', 'very unlikely', 'probably', 'probably not',
106   'possibly', 'plausibly', 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'confident', 'very confident',
107   'fairly confident', 'high confidence', 'low confidence', 'medium confidence',
108   'i am confident', 'i think', 'i believe', 'seems right', 'sounds right',
109   'certain', 'uncertain', 'sure', 'not sure', 'doubtful', 'no doubt',
110   'obviously', 'clearly', 'of course', 'trust me', 'nothing', 'none',
111 ]);
112 
113 function normalizeConfidence(text) {
114   return String(text).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
115 }
116 
117 /** Is `text` a bare self-rated confidence word/phrase (and so NOT a refutation)? True iff the
118  *  whole normalized value is in CONFIDENCE_WORDS. Pure; never throws. */
119 export function isConfidenceWord(text) {
120   if (typeof text !== 'string') return false;
121   const n = normalizeConfidence(text);
122   if (n === '') return false;
123   return CONFIDENCE_WORDS.has(n);
124 }
125 
126 /** Is `text` a NAMED CONCRETE DEFEATER? True iff it is populated AND is not a bare self-rated
127  *  confidence word. (Deterministic discriminator — judging the defeater's actual concreteness
128  *  is the advisory layer's job, PRINCIPLE-D; the gate rejects the un-falsifiable confidence
129  *  self-rating and requires the structural `refutation_provenance` alongside it.) Pure. */
130 export function isNamedDefeater(text) {
131   if (!isNonEmptyString(text)) return false;
132   return !isConfidenceWord(text);
133 }
134 
135 // --- the independent named-defeater refutation provenance envelope -------------------------
136 /** The refutation_provenance envelope marker: an INDEPENDENT named-defeater refuter ran. */
137 export const REFUTATION_PROVENANCE_KIND = 'independent-named-defeater';
138 
139 /** The STABLE identity of the elevation a refutation is bound to — the CLAIM-BINDING that closes the
140  *  cross-elevation REPLAY hole. A commission's result_digest is bound to THIS identity, so a provenance
141  *  legitimately minted for elevation A cannot authenticate a FABRICATED elevation B: B has a different
142  *  `id` / `reasoning` / named defeater — OR a different SUBSTANTIVE PAYLOAD (`verdict` / `severity` /
143  *  `value_if_true`) — ⇒ a different identity ⇒ the gate's recomputed digest no longer matches the ledger
144  *  tuple. The identity binds the elevation `id` PLUS EVERY substantive field a drafter could vary to
145  *  smuggle a false claim under a valid proof: its `reasoning`, its `what_would_refute_it` (the
146  *  named-defeater SUBJECT the finding is about), AND its payload `verdict` + `severity` + `value_if_true`
147  *  (the claim/rating a replay would try to fabricate under a genuine refutation's provenance). Trimmed +
148  *  fixed key order so the SAME elevation yields the SAME identity at MINT and at GATE (any divergence
149  *  would either reopen the hole or cause a false negative). A non-object elevation ⇒ null (a digest over
150  *  "no bound elevation" — the pre-claim-binding shape, still self-consistent). Pure; never throws. */
151 export function elevationIdentity(elevation) {
152   if (elevation === null || typeof elevation !== 'object' || Array.isArray(elevation)) return null;
153   return {
154     id: isNonEmptyString(elevation.id) ? elevation.id.trim() : '',
155     reasoning: isNonEmptyString(elevation.reasoning) ? elevation.reasoning.trim() : '',
156     what_would_refute_it: isNonEmptyString(elevation.what_would_refute_it)
157       ? elevation.what_would_refute_it.trim()
158       : '',
159     verdict: isNonEmptyString(elevation.verdict) ? elevation.verdict.trim() : '',
160     severity: isNonEmptyString(elevation.severity) ? elevation.severity.trim() : '',
161     value_if_true: isNonEmptyString(elevation.value_if_true) ? elevation.value_if_true.trim() : '',
162   };
163 }
164 
165 /** Compute the stable `result_digest` a refutation carries: a SHA-256 over the CLAIM-BOUND tuple —
166  *  the IDENTITY of the elevation being refuted (elevationIdentity: id + reasoning + named defeater) PLUS
167  *  the refuter's CONTENT (its named defeater, its survived/broke verdict, and any verdict text).
168  *  Canonicalized (fixed key order, trimmed) so the SAME refutation of the SAME elevation always yields
169  *  the SAME digest — the value the unforgeable commission-id (seam/commission-ledger.mjs) is
170  *  cryptographically BOUND to (W2a; claim-bound in the REPLAY-close hardening). Because the digest now
171  *  binds the elevation identity, a commission minted for elevation A produces a digest bound to A; when
172  *  that provenance is copied onto a different elevation B, the gate recomputes over B's identity and the
173  *  digest MISMATCHES ⇒ the replay is rejected. Stdlib-only; pure. */
174 export function computeResultDigest({ elevation = null, defeater, survived = true, verdict = null } = {}) {
175   const canonical = JSON.stringify({
176     elevation: elevationIdentity(elevation),
177     defeater: isNonEmptyString(defeater) ? defeater.trim() : '',
178     survived: survived === true,
179     verdict: verdict === undefined || verdict === null ? null : String(verdict),
180   });
181   return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonical, 'utf8').digest('hex');
182 }
183 
184 /** Mint a typed refutation_provenance envelope — the deterministic surface of the bare refuter
185  *  `agent()` seam. It records the named concrete defeater that was tried and whether the elevation
186  *  survived it. W2a extends the envelope with the CROSS-FAMILY provenance the commission-id ledger
187  *  binds: `drafter_family` (who authored the drafted claim), `refuter_family` (who ran the
188  *  refutation), and `result_digest` (a stable hash of the refuter's defeater + verdict content —
189  *  computeResultDigest). W2b also PERSISTS `verdict` so the digest re-derives faithfully from the
190  *  envelope's own content (isCrossFamilyRefutation check (c)).
191  *
192  *  W2b: the envelope no longer HARDCODES `independent: true`. Independence in the cross-family sense
193  *  (the drafter and refuter are DIFFERENT model families, established against the unforgeable ledger)
194  *  is DERIVED at the vet seam (isCrossFamilyRefutation), never self-asserted here — a hardcoded
195  *  `independent:true` was exactly the self-stamp the anti-overclaim runtime gate replaces.
196  *  `commission_id` is the ledger id the orchestrator minted for this refutation; W2b resolves it.
197  *  Throws when the defeater is missing or is a bare confidence word. */
198 export function composeRefutationProvenance({
199   elevation = null,
200   defeater,
201   survived = true,
202   verdict = null,
203   drafter_family = null,
204   refuter_family = null,
205   commission_id = null,
206 } = {}) {
207   if (!isNamedDefeater(defeater)) {
208     throw new Error('refute: composeRefutationProvenance requires a NAMED concrete defeater (a self-rated confidence word is not a refutation)');
209   }
210   return {
211     kind: REFUTATION_PROVENANCE_KIND,
212     defeater: defeater.trim(),
213     survived: survived === true,
214     verdict: verdict === undefined || verdict === null ? null : verdict,
215     drafter_family: drafter_family ?? null,
216     refuter_family: refuter_family ?? null,
217     // CLAIM-BOUND: the digest binds the IDENTITY of `elevation` (the finding being refuted) so this
218     // provenance cannot be replayed onto a different elevation. The MINT path MUST pass the SAME
219     // elevation whose id/reasoning/what_would_refute_it the GATE (isCrossFamilyRefutation) will read.
220     result_digest: computeResultDigest({ elevation, defeater, survived, verdict }),
221     refuter_commission_id: commission_id,
222   };
223 }
224 
225 // --- the honest un-refuted floor (ship SPECULATIVE + the stamp) ----------------------------
226 /** The stamp a finding carries when no independent refuter established it. */
227 export const NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP = 'no independent refutation ran';
228 /** The honest floor tier — an un-refuted finding may not rise above it. */
229 export const SPECULATIVE_TIER = 'SPECULATIVE';
230 
231 /** Downgrade `finding` to the honest SPECULATIVE floor and stamp it "no independent refutation
232  *  ran" — the explicit, non-silent route for a finding that did not earn an independent
233  *  named-defeater refutation. Returns a FRESH finding (existing keys keep insertion order, so a
234  *  reasoning-before-verdict finding stays reasoning-before-verdict). Throws on a non-object. */
235 export function stampNoIndependentRefutation(finding) {
236   if (finding === null || typeof finding !== 'object' || Array.isArray(finding)) {
237     throw new Error('refute: stampNoIndependentRefutation target is not an object');
238   }
239   return {
240     ...finding,
241     tier: SPECULATIVE_TIER,
242     no_independent_refutation: true,
243     refutation_stamp: NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP,
244   };
245 }
246 
247 /** Predicate: does `finding` carry the honest un-refuted-floor stamp? Pure; never throws. */
248 export function hasNoIndependentRefutationStamp(finding) {
249   return (
250     finding !== null &&
251     typeof finding === 'object' &&
252     finding.no_independent_refutation === true &&
253     finding.refutation_stamp === NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP
254   );
255 }
256 
257 /** The default commission verifier: a NO-OP that resolves nothing (returns null). With it, an
258  *  elevation can NEVER reach the cross-family tier (no ledger to authenticate its commission-id) —
259  *  the safe, conservative default when no real resolver is injected. The RUNTIME entry
260  *  (runtime/seam-pass.applySeamPass) injects the real ledger resolver
261  *  (seam/commission-ledger.resolveCommission) so the W2b gate is ACTIVE in a real run. Pure. */
262 export const NOOP_COMMISSION_VERIFIER = () => null;
263 
264 /** W2b — DERIVE whether an elevation's refutation is a GENUINE cross-family refutation, the SOLE gate
265  *  to the cross-family (GROUNDED) tier. TRUE iff the elevation's `refutation_provenance` carries a
266  *  commission-id that, resolved against the injected ledger `resolveCommission`, is ALL of:
267  *    (a) AUTHENTIC     — resolveCommission(id) returns a non-null tuple (orchestrator-minted,
268  *                        unforgeable; a forged / unminted / tampered id resolves to null);
269  *    (b) FAMILY-DISTINCT — the resolved drafter_family !== refuter_family (a same-family "refutation"
270  *                        earns no independent origin, so it can never cross the single-family ceiling);
271  *    (c) DIGEST-MATCHED — the resolved result_digest === computeResultDigest over the elevation's OWN
272  *                        IDENTITY (id + reasoning + named defeater) PLUS its refuter content (recomputed
273  *                        from the envelope's defeater/survived/verdict — never a stored/self-reported
274  *                        digest), so the ledger entry is CLAIM-BOUND to THIS elevation. A provenance
275  *                        minted for elevation A, copied onto a fabricated elevation B, recomputes over
276  *                        B's identity ⇒ mismatch ⇒ the cross-elevation REPLAY is rejected.
277  *  ANY failure ⇒ FALSE ⇒ the elevation cannot exceed the single-family PROMISING ceiling. The caller's
278  *  `--cross-model` intent flag NEVER enters here — cross-family is DERIVED from the ledger, never
279  *  asserted. Pure; never throws (a throwing resolver is treated as a non-resolution ⇒ false). */
280 export function isCrossFamilyRefutation(elevation, resolveCommission = NOOP_COMMISSION_VERIFIER) {
281   if (elevation === null || typeof elevation !== 'object' || Array.isArray(elevation)) return false;
282   const prov = elevation.refutation_provenance;
283   if (prov === null || typeof prov !== 'object' || Array.isArray(prov)) return false;
284   // The commission-id the orchestrator minted for this refutation (accept either envelope spelling).
285   const id = isNonEmptyString(prov.refuter_commission_id)
286     ? prov.refuter_commission_id
287     : (isNonEmptyString(prov.commission_id) ? prov.commission_id : null);
288   if (id === null) return false;
289   let resolved;
290   try {
291     resolved = typeof resolveCommission === 'function' ? resolveCommission(id) : null;
292   } catch {
293     return false; // a resolver that throws is a non-resolution — never a cross-family grant
294   }
295   // (a) AUTHENTIC — the ledger returned a well-formed tuple for this id.
296   if (resolved === null || typeof resolved !== 'object' || Array.isArray(resolved)) return false;
297   if (!isNonEmptyString(resolved.drafter_family) || !isNonEmptyString(resolved.refuter_family)) return false;
298   // (b) FAMILY-DISTINCT — drafter and refuter are different model families.
299   if (resolved.drafter_family === resolved.refuter_family) return false;
300   // (c) DIGEST-MATCHED — the ledger's digest binds THIS refutation's actual content AND THIS elevation's
301   //     identity (recomputed here; never a stored/self-reported digest). Passing `elevation` claim-binds
302   //     the digest: a provenance minted for elevation A, copied onto elevation B, recomputes over B's
303   //     identity (id + reasoning + named defeater) ⇒ mismatches the ledger tuple ⇒ the replay is rejected.
304   const recomputed = computeResultDigest({
305     elevation,
306     defeater: prov.defeater,
307     survived: prov.survived,
308     verdict: prov.verdict ?? null,
309   });
310   if (resolved.result_digest !== recomputed) return false;
311   return true;
312 }
313 
314 /** Vet an elevation against the refutation discipline (the auto-downgrade path the "FAILS /
315  *  auto-downgrades" done-when names). If the elevation carries a NAMED concrete defeater AND a
316  *  `refutation_provenance` envelope, it earned its tier and is returned unchanged (fresh copy).
317  *  Otherwise it is auto-downgraded to the SPECULATIVE floor + the no-independent-refutation
318  *  stamp — never silently left over-claimed. Returns a FRESH object; throws on a non-object.
319  *
320  *  W2b GATE: a `resolveCommission` verifier is injected via `options` (the RUNTIME entry wires the
321  *  real ledger resolver; tests pass a stub). An honestly-refuted elevation keeps its tier, and its
322  *  CROSS-FAMILY eligibility is DERIVED here (isCrossFamilyRefutation) and stamped onto the returned
323  *  elevation as `cross_family_refuted` — the ONLY signal downstream (passElevation/applySeamPass) may
324  *  use to let the elevation reach the cross-family (GROUNDED) tier or to set the derived top-level
325  *  `cross_model`. With the default NOOP resolver (or a resolver that rejects the id), the elevation is
326  *  honestly refuted but NOT cross-family (`cross_family_refuted:false`) ⇒ capped at PROMISING. */
327 export function vetElevationRefutation(elevation, options = {}) {
328   if (elevation === null || typeof elevation !== 'object' || Array.isArray(elevation)) {
329     throw new Error('refute: vetElevationRefutation target is not an object');
330   }
331   const { resolveCommission = NOOP_COMMISSION_VERIFIER } = options;
332   const honestlyRefuted = isNamedDefeater(elevation.what_would_refute_it) && isNonEmpty(elevation.refutation_provenance);
333   if (honestlyRefuted) {
334     // Cross-family (GROUNDED) eligibility is DERIVED from the unforgeable ledger — never asserted.
335     const cross_family_refuted = isCrossFamilyRefutation(elevation, resolveCommission);
336     return { ...elevation, cross_family_refuted };
337   }
338   return stampNoIndependentRefutation(elevation);
339 }

341 // --- the bounded refuter budget (HALT, never a silent drop) --------------------------------
342 /** Thrown when more independent refuters are requested than the bounded budget R allows. A
343  *  distinct class so the budget canary can assert the run HALTS rather than silently dropping. */
344 export class RefuterBudgetHalt extends Error {
345   constructor(requested, budget) {
346     super(
347       `refuter-budget HALT: ${requested} independent refuters requested but the bounded budget is R=${budget} — HALT for human (no silent drop; findings below the firing threshold ship SPECULATIVE with the "${NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP}" stamp)`
348     );
349     this.name = 'RefuterBudgetHalt';
350     this.requested = requested;
351     this.budget = budget;
352   }
353 }
354 
355 /** Assert a refuter request stays within the bounded budget R. Returns `requested` when it is
356  *  within budget; throws RefuterBudgetHalt (the HALT path) when it exceeds R — the run HALTS,
357  *  it does NOT silently take the first R. Throws a plain Error on a non-count argument. */
358 export function assertRefuterBudget(requested, R = REFUTER_BUDGET_R) {
359   if (!Number.isInteger(requested) || requested < 0) {
360     throw new Error(`refute: assertRefuterBudget requires a non-negative integer count, got ${JSON.stringify(requested)}`);
361   }
362   if (requested > R) throw new RefuterBudgetHalt(requested, R);
363   return requested;
364 }
